name: George Grenville
summary: British Prime Minister 1763–1765; Sugar Act and Stamp Act.

name: Pontiac
summary: Odawa (Ottawa) war chief who led the 1763 coalition against British posts in the Great Lakes region.

name: Jeffery Amherst
summary: British commander-in-chief in North America after the Seven Years' War; ended gift-giving to Native nations.

name: Neolin
summary: Lenape (Delaware) prophet whose message of rejecting European goods and ways influenced Pontiac's coalition.
